mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_item(service_name, service_type, medical_type, category, description, price, duration, image_url, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{serviceName}, #{serviceType}, #{medicalType}, #{category}, #{description}, #{price}, #{duration}, #{imageUrl}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update:
UPDATE service_item
service_name = #{serviceName},
service_type = #{serviceType},
medical_type = #{medicalType},
category = #{category},
description = #{description},
price = #{price},
duration = #{duration},
image_url = #{imageUrl},
status = #{status},
update_time = #{updateTime},
deleted = #{deleted},
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT si.*, COUNT(so.id) as order_count FROM service_item si JOIN service_order so ON si.id = so.service_id WHERE si.status = 1 AND si.deleted = 0 GROUP BY si.id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
